offers_products.reason: Designs and manufactures drilling tools such as stabilizers, reamers and RotoSteer, and sells some of them.

offers_services.reason: Tool rentals, Downhole Inspection Services (NDT) and repair for drilling operators are main offerings.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells only to oil, gas and geothermal operators and drilling service companies, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are oil and gas operators and oilfield service companies renting tools and buying inspection services.

recurring_revenue.reason: Operators and service companies repeatedly rent tools and order inspections across drilling programs, though there are no formal contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Oil and gas drilling activity and operator spending on rented drilling tools fall sharply when commodity prices drop.

big_ticket.reason: Tools are mostly rented per job and inspections are routine, so individual transactions are small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from rented tool fleet and manufactured tools, not from staff time; inspection is a smaller part.

large_customers.reason: Customers are major oil and gas operators and large oilfield service companies, per the site's 'foremost operators' wording.

asset_heavy.reason: Large rental fleet of downhole tools plus machining and inspection facilities needs ongoing capital investment to maintain and grow.

notes: Mainly tool rental, which is a service. Product sales and manufacturing are a smaller part of the business.
